title: NIST WebBook: Silicon is Si, molecular weight 28.0855 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Silicon as Si, molecular weight 28.0855 amu, CAS 7440-21-3.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Silicon, CAS Registry Number 7440-21-3, lists molecular formula Si and molecular weight 28.0855 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 27.9769265325 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/Si. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight.
